:::{#thm-marginal-mean-nonindep}

#### Marginal mean under an identity link when the covariates are associated

In the identity-link model of @eq-or-objections-identity-model,
suppose $\Ef{C|X=x} = \gamma_0 + \gamma_x x$.
Then:

$$\Ef{Y|X=x} = (\eta_0 + \b_C \gamma_0) + (\b_X + \b_C \gamma_x) x$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-marginal-model-non-indep.

:::
